title: Interativa Plasticos (Interplast)
description: Interativa Plasticos (Interplast brand, interativaplasticos.com.br) is a Brazilian plastics processor (HDPE/PEAD and PP compounds): commercial proposals, price lists (incl. scrap trade), NFe XML/PDF invoices, production and laboratory report templates (laudos), pigment-change records, and export tax spreadsheets.
